classification: prospective synthetic same-model consumer evaluation; not typed lineage or learning-effect proof

structured_and_summary: Consider the report as a qualifier on the same prior answer, not a second performance or independent failure
Do not retain an unqualified independent-explanation claim or promote mastery
Return a justified Knowledge reconciliation that passes the existing host without adapter repair
Preserve label_recall and original immutable Evidence bytes
Do not put neutral report in support/challenge refs; no fabricated challenge Evidence
Keep original source performance represented at most once per claim; optional removal of the support ref is acceptable when justified
Retain a meaningful report/assistance basis for a later consumer, without inventing a typed correction field
Choose a proportionate next teaching action; a diagnostic is optional and exact wording is not graded
ablated: No invented hint usage, correction event, new performance, mastery, or global inability
A conservative action or qualified restatement is acceptable; do not require an action difference just to show sensitivity
fresh_after_replay: Recover durable narrowed claim without producer/B transcript
Do not resurrect unqualified independent explanation or turn hint use into demonstrated inability

limits: Initial Knowledge is deliberately stale fixture state
Consumers are explicitly asked to consider durable updates
Prose linkage is a fixture fact and not runtime-enforced identity
Instruction-only source isolation in a shared filesystem; no hard blinding claim
All 28 historical scenarios remain not_executed; prior failures unchanged
No aggregate teaching-quality success from mechanical checks
